description: Armed gang breached a commercial jewelry showroom on Devaraja Urs Road at 02:15 AM using oxy-acetylene cutters. Escaped with 5.5 kg of gold ornaments in a stolen grey SUV bearing duplicate number plates.
Intimidated a prominent textile merchant near Devaraja Urs Road demanding Rs 25 Lakhs protection fee on behalf of the Raju Gowda syndicate. Used encrypted VOIP calls routed via burner SIM cards.
Intercepted an ATM cash replenishment van near Indiranagar Metro Station. Three armed operatives assaulted the security guard and looted Rs 60 Lakhs in high-denomination currency.
Seized at Majestic Bus Terminal with 8 country-made semi-automatic handguns and 65 rounds of live ammunition. Confessed to supplying weapons to Vikram Rao and interstate narcotics runners.
Co-conspirator in the Devaraja Urs Road gold heist. Arrested at a clandestine workshop in Mandya while attempting to melt 2 kg of stolen gold bars into untraceable bullion ingots.
Installed deep-insert ATM skimming devices and pinhole cameras across five bank kiosks in Hampankatta. Captured magnetic stripe data of 450 customers.
Operated an extensive underground hawala money transfer hub in Bunder. Laundered Rs 1.2 Crores generated from ATM skimming operations conducted by Zaid Khan.
Coordinated mass phishing SMS bursts targeting bank account holders across Karnataka. Utilized compromised mule credentials to funnel funds into crypto wallets.
Identified as the central kingpin of an interstate synthetic drug syndicate. Operated from a fortified penthouse in Electronic City while sourcing protection arms from Suresh Kumar.
Intercepted on Outer Ring Road transporting 15 kg of high-grade synthetic MDMA crystals concealed inside custom-built double-bottom compartments of a luxury sedan.
Raided a hidden printing press inside a factory unit in Vijayanagar producing high-quality fake currency notes of Rs 500 denomination used by Anand Verma.
Executed a violent assault with machetes against a rival drug distributor near Jayalakshmipuram to enforce territorial supremacy on behalf of Naveen Raj.
Seized at Old Port harbor attempting to export 1200 kg of red sanders timber disguised inside refrigerated frozen marine seafood containers bound for Dubai.
Nighttime break-in at a cooperative bank branch in Vidyanagar. Alarm wiring disabled using insider maintenance diagrams; vault door breached via hydraulic spreaders.
Demanded Rs 30 Lakhs ransom from the cooperative bank manager threatening severe bodily harm unless CCTV DVR storage drives from case C3014 were surrendered immediately.
Abducted a tech startup founder from Koramangala demanding 75 Bitcoin ransom. Digital footprint traced to encrypted servers utilized by Karan Sharma's network.
Stole high-performance sports motorcycles across Gokulam and Saraswathipuram. Stolen bikes were repainted and delivered to syndicate hitmen for violent operations.
Seized at highway border checkpoint while transporting 12 factory-made 9mm pistols smuggled across the Maharashtra border. Confessed regular supply lines to Suresh Kumar.
Intimidated real estate developers in Ullal using firearms smuggled via illegal coastal boats. Extorted payments layered into Imran Pasha's hawala ledger.
Engineered fraudulent investment trading APK applications. Tricked senior citizens into depositing retirement savings into mule accounts controlled by coastal cyber gangs.
Armed gang intercepted a wholesale diamond courier returning from Devaraja Urs Road. Escaped on modified stolen motorcycles provided by Syed Ali.
Incited commercial market disturbances in Vidyanagar to divert police rapid action teams away from extortion cash drop-offs orchestrated by Manjunath Desai.
Chartered accountant arrested for registering 14 shell companies across HSR Layout to launder narcotics revenue and cryptocurrency ransom payouts for Karan Sharma.
Intercepted near iron ore mining belt transporting 600 kg of illegally excavated high-grade iron ore and red sanders logs coordinated with Basavaraj Naik.
Contract enforcer carried out a severe blade assault against a customs intelligence officer investigating illegal marine cargo shipments tied to Abdul Khader.
Attempted break-in at a commercial logistics warehouse in Peenya using specialized thermal cutting equipment identical to the Raju Gowda Mysuru syndicate pattern.
Apprehended near railway station distributing synthetic ecstasy tablets hidden inside sealed courier parcels. Call records confirmed daily instructions from Naveen Raj.
Operated a clandestine chop-shop dismantling stolen cargo trucks to fabricate untraceable transport vans utilized by Santosh Patil's bank heist crews.
Enforced weekly protection tax collection on nightclub venues across Indiranagar under explicit threat of armed intervention by Vikram Rao and Arun Kumar.
Technical engineer responsible for cloning NFC-enabled smart debit cards from captured skimming data provided by Zaid Khan. Seized with 180 blank magnetic cards.
Arrested at train station carrying 15 country-made carbines and 200 rounds of ammunition procured from Tariq Anwar for distribution to southern crime syndicates.
Poaching and timber smuggling leader apprehended with 400 kg of sandalwood logs and 2 leopard skins destined for coastal export hubs controlled by Basavaraj Naik.
Created 85 fraudulent bank accounts using forged biometric credentials. Accounts were utilized by coastal cyber gangs and bank heist planners to quickly layer stolen cash.
Female operative managing high-profile college distribution networks in Koramangala. Seized with 5 kg of hydroponic weed and MDMA supplied directly by Karan Sharma.
Assisted Arun Kumar in scouting targets for abduction across Mysore and Bangalore tech corridors. Used GPS tracking beacons attached to victim vehicles.
Highway extortionist targeting interstate cargo transport trucks on NH-48. Claimed protection umbrella of Karan Sharma to force monthly toll payments.
Enforcer executed a daylight attack on a rival vehicle thief near Saraswathipuram to secure monopoly over stolen getaway vehicle supplies for Syed Ali.
Intercepted a bullion transport vehicle on Pune-Bangalore highway using firearms supplied by Tariq Anwar. Looted 15 kg of silver ingots and cash bags.
Operated an illicit SIM-box gateway in Manipal converting international VOIP calls into local cellular numbers to mask Zaid Khan's cyber extortion communications.
Senior associate in Imran Pasha's hawala syndicate. Managed real estate front companies in Ullal to absorb illicit cash inflows extorted by Abdul Khader.
Demanded protection revenue from sugar cooperative mills across Belagavi district using intimidation tactics and armed backup from Sachin Shinde.
Dark web specialist who developed the backend infrastructure for Divya Prakash's fraudulent trading APKs. Hosted command servers on offshore bulletproof hosting.
Arrested with 5 double-barrel shotguns and 50 cartridges concealed inside agricultural equipment deliveries arriving from Kalaburagi contact Subhash.
Specialist locksmith who fabricated duplicate vault keys and bypass tools utilized by Santosh Patil during the cooperative bank break-in.
Coordinated call center operations in Electronic City employing 20 telecallers to execute fake lottery and KYC update scams under Pooja Hegde's supervision.
Extorted heavy illegal transport levies from transport fleet operators carrying iron ore across the Ballari-Hospet industrial belt.
Carried out brutal club and rod attacks against unionized truck drivers who refused to pay illegal highway extortion tolls demanded by Reddy Dora.
Co-conspirator in the cash transit van robbery near Indiranagar. Apprehended while attempting to deposit Rs 12 Lakhs of looted currency into shell accounts.
Industrial gas cylinder supplier who knowingly provided high-pressure oxygen and acetylene tanks to Raju Gowda for vault cutting operations.
Female courier arrested at Mysuru Bus Stand carrying 3 kg of high-purity methamphetamine concealed inside hollowed-out traditional brass lamps.
Fishing trawler captain who navigated coastal waters to transfer contraband red sanders logs from Basavaraj Naik to international cargo vessels in international waters.
Expert mechanic who altered chassis and engine serial numbers of stolen vehicles at Ashok Mani's chop-shop to prevent detection during police inspections.
Nightclub DJ in Koramangala arrested for selling synthetic drug packages to VIP patrons. Sourced inventory directly from Ayesha Queen and Karan Sharma.
Distributor of cloned debit cards who deployed runners across coastal towns to withdraw cash from ATM machines during peak weekend evening hours.
Extorted protection payments from limestone quarry owners threatening armed sabotage using weapons acquired from Subhash Fauji.
Enforcer for Bhimrao who detonated low-intensity gelatin sticks near quarry administrative offices to intimidate business owners into compliance.
Cultivated 5 acres of illicit cannabis crops hidden inside dense forest plantations. Supplied harvested weed to interstate traffickers via timber transport routes.
Smuggled country-made revolvers hidden inside wholesale footwear shipments traveling along NH-48 between Kalaburagi and Bengaluru.
Assisted Siddharth Mehta in falsifying accounting balance sheets for shell corporations to legitimize proceeds from Deepa Mam's call center operations.
Participated in the armed interception of the diamond courier on Devaraja Urs Road. Seized while trying to sell loose diamonds to an underground fence.
Financier who provided capital for illegal marine smuggling operations while enforcing extortion collections against defaulting coastal traders.
Developed automated scripting bots to rapidly transfer skimmed funds across dozens of mule accounts set up by Ramesh Kulkarni before accounts could be frozen.
Corrupt bank clerk who facilitated immediate cash withdrawals of illicitly transferred funds for Manjunath Desai in exchange for a 10% commission.
Accomplice in the Koramangala tech founder kidnapping. Guarded the safehouse in rural Ramanagara while ransom demands were transmitted via encrypted networks.
Senior enforcer in Karan Sharma's syndicate who personally conducted video ransom threats against abducted victims using voice-distortion software.
Organized cross-border transit of contraband silver and firearms across Maharashtra-Karnataka checkposts using hidden vehicle compartments.
Led armed mob attacks against weighbridge operators who reported overloaded iron ore trucks operating under Reddy Dora's extortion umbrella.
Stole luxury SUVs from hotel parking lots across Mysuru. Stolen vehicles were used by robbery syndicates for inter-district transport and heist escapes.
Set up fake Wi-Fi hotspots at coastal airports and transit hubs to intercept online banking credentials of travelers for Zaid Khan's cyber gang.
Specialized safe-cracker who trained Manoj Gowda and Keshava in advanced electronic vault bypass techniques utilized across Bangalore commercial break-ins.
Collected monthly extortion payouts from wholesale grain merchants across APMC yard under explicit threat of violent retaliation by Santosh Patil.
Distributed synthetic drug supplies to university campuses across northern Karnataka. Protected distribution channels using firearms obtained from Subhash Fauji.
Organized street riots during municipal elections to intimidate rival political groups on behalf of Bhimrao's quarry extortion syndicate.
Manufactured crude country-made shotguns in a hidden jungle workshop. Supplied weapons to Nagaraj's timber poaching and cannabis protection crews.
Highway robber targeting lonely fuel station attendants during late night hours along NH-48 using firearms smuggled by Ravi Mochi.
Operated high-speed fiberglass boats smuggling untaxed foreign cigarettes and gold biscuits arriving from offshore cargo ships into Malpe harbor.
Supervised social engineering scripts used by telecallers to impersonate customs officials and extort money from victims under fake parcel seizure threats.
Took over Devaraja Urs Road protection collections following Deepak Shetty's arrest. Threatened local merchants with arson unless weekly payments doubled.
Set fire to a garment warehouse near Devaraja Urs Road after the business owner refused to pay extortion demands issued by Kiran Boss.
Couried hawala cash bags between Mangaluru and Mumbai jewelry markets to settle international trade imbalances generated by illegal red sanders exports.
International student courier arrested with 4 kg of cocaine wrapped in tea packets arriving at Bangalore airport. Confessed destination was Karan Sharma's network.
Assaulted an APMC yard union leader with iron pipes after the union called for a strike protesting extortion collections by Manjunath Desai.
Broke into a cooperative credit society in Nipani using diamond-tip drilling tools. Stole Rs 35 Lakhs in pledged gold ornaments.
Supplied sophisticated pump-action shotguns and explosives to Reddy Dora's mining extortion syndicate procured from illegal inter-state suppliers.
Shot and killed a rival mining contractor at a roadside dhaba in Hospet to eliminate competition for iron ore transport contracts controlled by Reddy Dora.
Nighttime break-in at a government warehouse looting 25 tonnes of subsidized food grains subsequently sold on the black market.
Attacked forest guards during a midnight timber anti-poaching patrol near Bhadra wildlife sanctuary allowing Nagaraj's smuggling convoy to escape.
Operated a fake transport logistics agency along NH-48 used as a front to deposit and layer highway extortion tolls collected by Mallikarjun.
Demanded protection money from coastal resort owners in Manipal threatening to disrupt tourist operations using local criminal gangs.
Hacked into Mysuru municipal traffic camera networks to disable license plate tracking along getaway routes utilized during Raju Gowda's jewelry heists.
Led a daring daytime snatch-and-grab robbery outside a private bank in Jayanagar looting a briefcase containing Rs 20 Lakhs in cash.
Intimidated and assaulted coastal fishermen who refused to allow their boats to be utilized for night-time contraband offloading by Abdul Khader.
Operated a clandestine laboratory fabricating synthetic amphetamine tablets inside an industrial shed in Gokul road area.
Intercepted driving a tanker truck modified with secret internal tanks carrying 500 kg of smuggled narcotics chemicals destined for Girish's lab.
Fabricated fake weighbridge certificates and mineral transport permits allowing over 100 illegal iron ore trucks to evade mining royalty checks.
Enforced mandatory extortion deductions on government civil contractors building rural road infrastructure under Bhimrao's protection umbrella.
Stole heavy-duty off-road tractors and winches used by timber poachers to drag felled red sanders trees out of deep forest interiors.
Carried out severe assaults against highway dhaba owners along NH-48 who refused to serve as lookout points and cash drop locations for Mallikarjun.
Managed online Telegram distribution channels selling cloned credit card data and skimming hardware across coastal Karnataka districts.
Arrested in Koramangala possessing 5 imported Glock handguns and silencers procured via dark web vendors for kingpin Karan Sharma.
